extensionDescription.message: Save and restore site logins on this device, or move them with a password-protected backup file.

restrictedPage.message: Identiti can’t use this page. Open the website you want to save or restore.

loadError.message: Identiti couldn’t finish. Try again. If you were changing logins, look for Undo last restore.

exportNothingSelected.message: There is nothing to export from this page.

welcomeBody.message: Save a website’s login to switch accounts later or move it to another device. Identiti doesn’t upload your data.
